description: AIWEB Call lets ChatGPT Call a published AIWEB Page — a person or a business — and receive a Callback on the same Receipt. Powered by Voice over AI (VoA). Voice over AIWEB is the implementation. Resolve by name or by intention. Continue the same Receipt for follow-ups — never a second Call for Q&A. Play public audio or video is available. The app does not take payment or Instant Checkout in ChatGPT.
